HB 3093 Summary: Provides persons licensed to carry concealed handgun in another state with protections provided to persons with Oregon concealed handgun license if other state recognizes Oregon concealed handgun licenses and person who qualifies for license in other state would also qualify in Oregon.

Status: The 2015 Legislative session has ended as of Monday, 6/6. The bill was stuck in the Senate rules committee and wasn't discussed or brought up in the committee's sessions. I don't exactly know what this means but I guess the bill is dead? Does anyone know more about this than me?

 

SB 173 Summary: Authorizes person licensed to carry concealed handgun to present valid license instead of providing firearm to peace officer for examination when possessing firearm in public building.

Status: This bill has been passed and signed into law by Governor Brown on 6/30. This law will take effect on 1/1/2016.

 

SB 941 Summary: Requires private person to complete transfer of firearm by appearing with transferee before gun dealer to request criminal background check or shipping or delivering firearm to gun dealer in certain circumstances.

Status: For those who don't know, this bill was passed and signed into law on 5/11. This law took effect immediately as it was declared an emergency.
